# Fridge Contents Inventory

## Top Shelf
- **Butter lettuce/leaf lettuce** — 1–2 large heads — looks very fresh
- **Watermelon radish** — 1, halved — freshly cut, use soon
- **Kohlrabi** — 1–2 — looks fresh
- **Red cabbage** — 1 half head — freshly cut, use within a few days
- **White cabbage/napa cabbage** — partial head — looks fresh

## Second Shelf
- **Baby carrots/small carrots** — ~15–20 pieces — fresh
- **Spinach/chard leaves** — large bunch, ~200–300g — looks fresh
- **Broccoli** — ~2 crowns — fresh and green
- **Beetroot** — 1 whole — fresh
- **Bell pepper** — 1 green — partially visible

## Third Shelf
- **Feta cheese** — ~200–300g block — in container
- **Butter** — 1 block, ~200g — in container
- **Tomato sauce/salsa** — 2 large jars — home-preserved
- **Small dark condiment jar** — 1 small jar — contents unclear
- **Olives or preserved fruit** — 1 jar — dark contents
- **Eggs** — ~6–8 eggs — visible on right

## Bottom Shelf
- **Preserved tomatoes** — 1 large jar — home-preserved
- **Fresh parsley** — 1 large bunch — looks fresh
- **Orange juice** — ~300–400ml in glass pitcher — use soon
- **Lemons** — 2–3 — fresh
